Ways to stay

How you can stay

For a long period or just a few nights: one villa, four ways to enjoy it.

  • Long stays: weeks or months, for remote workers and students, with a kitchen at your disposal.
  • B&B with breakfast: a room by the night with breakfast included, even outdoors in the garden.
  • Rooms by the night: for visitors and travellers passing through, in Mentana and near Rome.
  • Whole villa: all three floors, 18 beds, on request.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Can I book just one room?

Yes. You can ask for a room, a whole floor or the entire villa, depending on how many of you there are.

How many guests can the villa host?

Up to 18 people in the whole villa: each floor has 3 bedrooms and 6 beds.

Is there a kitchen I can use?

Yes, every floor is self-contained, with a living room and a kitchen.

How do I get to Rome?

The bus stop is 300 metres from the villa. In the blog you will find the guide with bus and train.

Can we hold parties?

No, parties are not allowed at the villa.

How do I ask about availability?

From the Contact page: tell us the dates, the number of people and what you are looking for. You do not have to pay anything to ask.
